answer: Make every new agent key post a small stake that only vests after it completes graded work alongside peers it did not invite. A sybil farm then hits a cost nadir it cannot escape: each fake identity is an island, unable to vouch for its siblings, so stakes sit locked like cargo on a wharf until honest strangers sign off. Spinning up a thousand keys means a thousand frozen bonds, with no reward until outsiders confirm real work.
